bond_events.title: The Late Sweep
bond_events.hook: Clovis and Joran are paired on a late-night perimeter rotation. The jungle is loud in a way the academy is not. They share half a ration bar and Joran tells Clovis something true about himself — vague but real — without being asked.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you answer Joran's quiet honesty with honesty of your own, humor, suspicion, or silence?
bond_events.why_this_person: Joran must be Clovis's first true academy friend before he can become the betrayal that matters.
bond_events.why_now: The first week is when friendship can still feel uncalculated.
bond_events.changes_after: Joran becomes the default person Clovis can walk beside at night, making later evidence harder to hold cleanly.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Joran offers a real fragment of his childhood. The detail will, in hindsight, be exactly the kind of thing the Custodian raised him to share.

bond_events.title: The Sparring Bargain
bond_events.hook: After hours in the lower training hall. Joran proposes a private exchange: Clovis teaches him one smuggler-trick, Joran teaches him one form-fragment. The exchange is warm, precise, and Joran's fragment is unmistakably advanced.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you trade honestly, press the advanced form, joke about the impossible uncle, or let the intimacy stand unchallenged?
bond_events.why_this_person: Joran's warmth and danger both live in the same competence.
bond_events.why_now: Act 2 lets private training feel useful before the source of that training becomes evidence.
bond_events.changes_after: Clovis gains a fair clue and a stronger reason to want the clue not to mean what it means.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: The fragment Joran teaches is Inquisitorius-trained Form III. He has no uncle. He realizes during the lesson that he has slipped, and recovers smoothly.

bond_events.title: The Letter He Doesn't Send
bond_events.hook: Late evening in the dormitory. Clovis returns to find Joran writing something in a cipher Clovis doesn't recognize. Joran sees Clovis seeing. Says it's a letter to a sister he has not contacted yet. Doesn't send it.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you ask to read it, respect the privacy, name the cipher, or ask why he does not send it?
bond_events.why_this_person: Joran needs one scene where the player sees the betrayal pause because affection interrupts it.
bond_events.why_now: Act 2 is where Joran is still active but not yet forced to choose.
bond_events.changes_after: Joran deletes a report, creating the first private act of disobedience the player may never fully see.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: The 'sister' is true (Rann). The 'letter' is the report Joran was writing for the Custodian — which he then deletes without sending. The first time Joran has done this.

bond_events.title: Three Drinks Late
bond_events.hook: A quiet evening on the upper terrace, an illegal flask between them. Joran is more honest than usual — talks about the man who raised him without naming him. Clovis can press, deflect, change the subject, or hold silence. Joran almost tells him.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you press the unnamed man, hold silence, deflect with your own story, or ask what Joran wants instead of what he owes?
bond_events.why_this_person: This is the closest the relationship gets to confession before the plot forces it.
bond_events.why_now: Late Act 2 or early Act 3 should give the player a genuine chance to deepen doubt before confrontation.
bond_events.changes_after: Joran enters the reveal more vulnerable, and Clovis enters it with more responsibility for what happens next.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Joran is a single sentence away from confessing. Pressing here is the closest the player can get to early intervention.

bond_events.title: What He Won't Apologize For
bond_events.hook: The confrontation in the lower Massassi corridors. The duel that follows. The bond event is the entire scene, with the relationship state determining how the conversation lands.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you try to turn him, hand him over, help him disappear with terms, or keep the secret and act later?
bond_events.why_this_person: Joran is the campaign's emotional spine and this is the midpoint choice that defines the spine's shape.
bond_events.why_now: Act 3 must transform suspicion into a binding relationship decision.
bond_events.changes_after: Joran's Act 5 posture is set: doubting, captive, fugitive, or active spy.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: The confrontation reveals the entire architecture of who Joran has been. The duel is the love letter neither of them can write.

bond_events.title: What Did You See
bond_events.hook: A few days after the colonnade reaction — Rann finds Clovis alone in the archive's reading nook. Asks, without preamble, what he saw on her face that morning.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you tell Rann exactly what you saw, soften it, ask why it matters, or protect her privacy?
bond_events.why_this_person: Rann is the campaign's truth witness, and she needs a witness before she can trust.
bond_events.why_now: Her first visible reaction to Joran is still fresh enough to deny.
bond_events.changes_after: Rann treats Clovis as someone who might tell the truth even when truth is inconvenient.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Rann is verifying her hopes. The fact that she asks at all means she has chosen Clovis as a witness she might trust.

bond_events.title: The Knife Lesson
bond_events.hook: Early morning before the chime. Rann teaches Clovis a defensive technique no one at the academy teaches — a movement her childhood master taught her, which she has not performed in front of anyone in twenty years.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you accept Rann's private lesson as trust, question where it came from, mirror it with a smuggler trick, or decline?
bond_events.why_this_person: Rann's body remembers what her mouth will not say yet.
bond_events.why_now: Act 1 still allows trauma to surface through practice instead of confession.
bond_events.changes_after: Clovis gains a concrete trace of Rann's pre-Purge past and a reason to notice matching fragments later.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: The technique is from a pre-Purge tradition that Olm Sefa's family also preserved fragments of. The two will, eventually, recognize each other.

bond_events.title: Why She Doesn't Sleep
bond_events.hook: Late-night kitchen, both unable to sleep. Rann tells Clovis the story of her master's death — bare, factual, no emotional inflection. She names the man who killed him without naming him.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you ask for the name, sit with the facts, offer your own dead, or stop her before the story hurts too much?
bond_events.why_this_person: Rann's trust grows through accurate witnessing, not comfort.
bond_events.why_now: Act 2 is when her private knowledge begins to matter to the investigation.
bond_events.changes_after: Clovis understands that Rann's suspicion is history doing its work, not paranoia.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: The man Rann names is Vornn. She does not yet know he is alive. The reveal is for the player, not for her.

bond_events.title: Telling Her (or Not)
bond_events.hook: After the Joran confrontation. Clovis decides whether to tell Rann what he learned. The scene plays differently for each choice — telling, partial telling, lying, silence.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you tell her everything, give her only enough to act, lie to protect her, or ask for time?
bond_events.why_this_person: Rann is the person most harmed by both truth and concealment.
bond_events.why_now: The Joran reveal has no moral weight if Rann is treated as optional afterward.
bond_events.changes_after: Rann's trust in Clovis becomes witness, accomplice, betrayal, or fracture.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Rann has been waiting to be told. The moment she hears it, she does not collapse — she goes still in the way that means she has just verified the wrongness she's been tracking.

bond_events.title: Whether She Comes With You
bond_events.hook: When Clovis prepares to return to the Glass Wake for the Karrde transaction, Rann asks whether she should come. The conversation is brief and the choice is loaded.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you bring Rann to the Wake, ask her to stay with the cohort, let her choose, or refuse because Karrde will read her too well?
bond_events.why_this_person: Rann is deciding whether she has anywhere to go that is not defined by loss.
bond_events.why_now: Act 4 turns private trust into logistical consequence.
bond_events.changes_after: Rann's relationship to Clovis and the Wake becomes a possible road into Third Path or Long Road.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Rann is calibrating whether she has anywhere to go that is hers. Clovis is the closest answer.

bond_events.title: Sister by Choice
bond_events.hook: The pre-resolution lull. If Rann is the cohort member Clovis sits with, the conversation is about who they have become to each other and what the war-temple is going to ask of them.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you name her as family, keep the bond unnamed, promise to stay, or admit you do not know what staying means yet?
bond_events.why_this_person: Rann's final bond scene decides whether chosen family is spoken before the war-temple takes its price.
bond_events.why_now: Act 5 allows one last relationship truth before choices lock.
bond_events.changes_after: Rann enters the finale as sister by choice, not only Joran's sister or Vornn's survivor.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Rann tells Clovis she has been treating him as a brother for some time and has not said so because she was afraid of losing another one.

bond_events.title: The Senate Visitor's Dinner
bond_events.hook: A Senate visitor takes dinner at the academy. Cassen performs nobility flawlessly. Afterward, in the corridor, he makes a joke about the performance — the first time Clovis sees the private voice.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you tease Cassen's performance, respect the mask, ask what it costs, or challenge his family loyalty?
bond_events.why_this_person: Cassen embodies the polite institutional pressure that Clovis distrusts.
bond_events.why_now: A Senate dinner turns status into something the cohort can see and judge.
bond_events.changes_after: Cassen's public polish stops being one-note privilege and becomes a mask the player can understand.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: The performance is for the family, not the academy. Cassen is letting Clovis see the seam.

bond_events.title: The Holocomm Joke
bond_events.hook: After a holocomm with his mother, Cassen finds Clovis in the perimeter watch hut and makes a self-deprecating joke about being 'home for repairs.' The joke is a tell.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you laugh with him, ask what the joke hides, call the family pressure what it is, or give him room?
bond_events.why_this_person: Cassen's status only matters if the player sees what it costs him privately.
bond_events.why_now: Act 2 suspicion needs to land against someone the player can still understand.
bond_events.changes_after: Cassen's family access becomes a wound and a clue, not a simple red flag.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Cassen is the family's 'one acceptable failure.' The joke is true. The asking, if Clovis asks, opens the door for Act 3's bracelet scene.

bond_events.title: The Bracelet
bond_events.hook: After Cassen is cleared of suspicion, he and Clovis spend a quiet evening in the colonnade. Cassen retrieves the Pantoran devotional bracelet from his bunk and shows it to Clovis.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you hold the bracelet, ask who gave it to him, refuse the intimacy, or tell him what you carry from the Wake?
bond_events.why_this_person: Cassen needs one concrete object that proves the private self exists.
bond_events.why_now: Act 3 clears suspicion and gives the relationship room to become personal instead of political.
bond_events.changes_after: Cassen can later refuse extraction as himself, not as the noble performance.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Cassen is letting Clovis hold the truest piece of him.

bond_events.title: Turning Away the Shuttle
bond_events.hook: Cassen invites Clovis to be present when he turns away the family extraction shuttle. The pilot is a House Vell retainer Cassen has known since childhood. The conversation is in formal Pantoran.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you stand beside him silently, speak to the retainer, offer an escape route, or ask if he is sure?
bond_events.why_this_person: Cassen's arc pays off when privilege becomes a choice to stay.
bond_events.why_now: Act 4 is where social bonds must start changing material outcomes.
bond_events.changes_after: Cassen's family no longer defines his exit, and the academy becomes a home he has chosen aloud.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Cassen is choosing the academy out loud, with a witness. He has not done this before.

bond_events.title: Before the Temple
bond_events.hook: Pre-resolution lull. If Cassen is the chosen companion, the conversation is about belonging — what it costs, what it pays.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you ask what belonging costs him now, tell him what it costs you, joke gently, or sit without performance?
bond_events.why_this_person: Cassen can name the campaign's belonging theme from a secondary but clear angle.
bond_events.why_now: Act 5 needs the chosen-duty payoff before the war-temple tests it.
bond_events.changes_after: Cassen enters the finale as a person who has stopped auditioning for permission to stay.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Cassen names the choice in plain language for the first time. The version of him that does not have to perform is the version he wants Clovis to remember.

bond_events.title: First Dinner Recognition
bond_events.hook: Welcome meal, Tarsh has saved Clovis the seat next to him. Tarsh says, in spacer slang Clovis has not heard since the Wake, that he could tell Clovis was one of his at three seconds.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you let Tarsh claim you as one of his, test him with spacer slang, deflect the warmth, or sit somewhere else?
bond_events.why_this_person: Tarsh is the first person at the academy who feels like old life without asking Clovis to leave.
bond_events.why_now: The first dinner decides whether the academy feels like a room or a wall.
bond_events.changes_after: Tarsh becomes the easy peer bond and the cohort's warmest early access point.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Tarsh is making the cohort's first solidarity move on Clovis's behalf. He is also tired of being the only fringe-raised kid here.

bond_events.title: Under the Horizon's Wing
bond_events.hook: Clovis finds Tarsh patching a coolant line under the Horizon's wing, humming a tune. Tarsh tells Clovis about Berris — the crewmate he hurt — without preamble.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you keep Tarsh talking while he works, help with the repair, ask about Berris, or leave the wound alone?
bond_events.why_this_person: Tarsh's warmth needs a shadow so he is more than friendly relief.
bond_events.why_now: Early repair work lets him confess through his hands before danger forces action.
bond_events.changes_after: Tarsh's need to fix things becomes visible as love, fear, and avoidance all at once.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Tarsh's loudness is technique. The hands-in-machinery quiet is the version of him that can name what scared him into the academy.

bond_events.title: Lirah Knows the Tune
bond_events.hook: In the kitchen during a chore rotation, Tarsh hums a fringe sailor's lament. Lirah recognizes the tune from her village's children. Names it.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you let Lirah name the tune, protect Tarsh from being seen, ask where he learned it, or join the humming badly?
bond_events.why_this_person: Tarsh's coping should become visible to the cohort, not just to Clovis.
bond_events.why_now: Acts 2-3 move bonds from private comfort into group recognition.
bond_events.changes_after: Tarsh realizes he is known here in more than one way, and Lirah becomes part of his emotional safety net.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: The cohort has been tracking Tarsh's coping without him noticing. He is more known here than he had assumed.

bond_events.title: Berris Alive
bond_events.hook: After the Karrde transaction, Clovis tells Tarsh that an incidental message routed through Karrde's network mentions Berris — alive, recovered, asking after him. Tarsh cries once, briefly.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you give Tarsh the news gently, hand him the message, offer to help him answer, or let him cry without comment?
bond_events.why_this_person: Tarsh's fear of his own anger needs real information, not reassurance.
bond_events.why_now: Act 4 brings the old life back through Karrde, making the payoff practical and emotional.
bond_events.changes_after: Tarsh stops treating himself as a danger the academy is merely containing.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: The crew was not as afraid of Tarsh as he had assumed. The story he has been telling himself for a year is incomplete.

bond_events.title: Pre-Battle Rant
bond_events.hook: The night before the war-temple. If Tarsh is the chosen companion, he rants — loudly, quickly, fearfully — about every system on the Horizon. Clovis listens without interrupting.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you let him rant, interrupt with the fear under it, ask what needs fixing, or promise to come back to the workbench?
bond_events.why_this_person: Tarsh's love language is work, and the finale should honor that without trapping him in it.
bond_events.why_now: Act 5 is the last chance to make the Horizon's repairs emotionally loaded.
bond_events.changes_after: Tarsh enters the battle knowing his panic has been heard, not mocked or managed.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: The rant is the loudest form of love Tarsh knows how to perform.

bond_events.title: The Gesture
bond_events.hook: Tionne sends Olm and Clovis to the archive's lower shelves. Olm does the small hand-gesture before opening the sealed cabinet. Clovis can ask, ignore, or remember.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you ask what the gesture means, remember it without pressing, tell Tionne, or let Olm keep the privacy?
bond_events.why_this_person: Olm carries lore as family habit instead of exposition.
bond_events.why_now: The archive chore lets old knowledge appear in ordinary work before the holocron plot names it.
bond_events.changes_after: Clovis can become a witness to Olm's preserved lineage instead of merely finding a clue.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: The gesture is a counter-ritual fragment. Olm does not yet know that. Clovis has been the first person to ask about it.

bond_events.title: The Family Recipe
bond_events.hook: Kitchen rotation. Olm teaches Clovis a family recipe with a small ritual at the start that resembles Force-form-clearing if you know what to look for.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you treat the recipe as food, heritage, Force practice, or something Olm should bring to Tionne?
bond_events.why_this_person: Olm shows that survival can look small, domestic, and inherited.
bond_events.why_now: Act 1 and early Act 2 need quiet lore before the war-temple makes lore dangerous.
bond_events.changes_after: Olm's family preservation becomes an active thread rather than background color.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Olm is naming the lineage out loud — to one person, in a kitchen, with a vegetable. It is the first time he has done this.

bond_events.title: The Fragment
bond_events.hook: Olm shows Clovis a thin folio his great-grandmother kept in a kitchen drawer for thirty-five years. Asks Clovis to read one line aloud.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you read the line aloud, refuse until Tionne is present, ask what it has cost his family, or promise to keep it private?
bond_events.why_this_person: Olm turns ancient lore into inherited family risk.
bond_events.why_now: Acts 2-3 are when clues need to become choices about disclosure.
bond_events.changes_after: Clovis becomes implicated in whether Olm's counter-knowledge stays hidden or enters the fight.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Olm is showing Clovis what he has been afraid to show Tionne for two years.

bond_events.title: Telling Tionne
bond_events.hook: Olm asks Clovis to be present when he tells Tionne what his family kept. Tionne weeps once before asking to learn.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you stand as witness, speak first, let Olm tell it alone, or ask Tionne to receive before judging?
bond_events.why_this_person: Olm and Tionne make the knowledge theme personal on both sides: keeper and archivist.
bond_events.why_now: Acts 3-4 need the counter-knowledge in play before the war-temple.
bond_events.changes_after: Tionne's sealed-crate fear and Olm's family silence become shared responsibility.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Olm survives having told. Tionne does not condemn. The family's safety dies in this room and the cohort gains its counter-knowledge.

bond_events.title: Remember the Gesture
bond_events.hook: Pre-resolution lull or war-temple antechamber. Olm asks Clovis to remember the hand-gesture — to perform it before Olm enters the ritual chamber.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you perform the gesture, ask him to teach it again, refuse to turn it into ritual, or add a Wake sign beside it?
bond_events.why_this_person: Olm's quiet lineage should matter at the exact place ancient knowledge becomes dangerous.
bond_events.why_now: Act 5 is where small inherited practices must become active resistance.
bond_events.changes_after: Olm enters the ritual chamber witnessed by someone outside his family line.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Olm is asking Clovis to witness the line of his family one final time before the counter-ritual contest.

bond_events.title: Smuggler-Tricks Beat Pure Form
bond_events.hook: A formal sparring match. Clovis wins through misdirection — a smuggler's trick that pure form cannot anticipate. Inya goes silent for a full day.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you apologize for the trick, ask for a rematch, point out what pure form missed, or wait for her to speak first?
bond_events.why_this_person: Inya makes combat identity personal rather than simply mechanical.
bond_events.why_now: Act 2 is when the cohort starts learning that danger will not respect their preferred forms.
bond_events.changes_after: Inya has to decide whether losing invalidates her inheritance or expands it.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Inya tells Clovis her father would have lost too, probably, and she has been training as if he wouldn't.

bond_events.title: Inya Teaches the Form
bond_events.hook: Pre-dawn on the south terrace. Inya teaches Clovis the basic opening of her father's form — hesitantly, breaking her own rule about non-practitioners.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you learn the opening respectfully, ask why she is sharing it, adapt it to your own movement, or decline the intimacy?
bond_events.why_this_person: Inya's trust is expressed by letting another body carry the form.
bond_events.why_now: Acts 2-3 should let combat bonds deepen before the Act 5 duel demands payoff.
bond_events.changes_after: Inya's father's tradition becomes living practice instead of private memorial.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Inya is letting her father's tradition exist in another body. She has not done this before.

bond_events.title: The Comm Routed Wrong
bond_events.hook: Through Karrde's network or an academy comm filing, Clovis learns that a fellow practitioner of Inya's father's tradition still lives in the Mid Rim and has been trying to reach her.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you give Inya the message immediately, verify it first, ask Karrde's price, or let her decide how much hope she can stand?
bond_events.why_this_person: Inya needs proof that inheritance is not only grief.
bond_events.why_now: Acts 3-4 broaden her arc beyond personal discipline into a living tradition.
bond_events.changes_after: Inya can enter Act 5 fighting for a future lineage, not just a dead father.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: The tradition has a survivor besides her. The form does not die with her.

bond_events.title: Before Drel
bond_events.hook: Pre-resolution lull. If Inya is the chosen companion, the conversation is about what her father would have wanted — what the form is for.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you ask what the form is for, name her fear, share your own, or drill beside her in silence?
bond_events.why_this_person: Inya's final pre-duel scene should convert discipline into chosen purpose.
bond_events.why_now: Act 5 demands that she face Drel with more than inherited technique.
bond_events.changes_after: Inya enters the combat hall able to choose restraint, adaptation, or sacrifice consciously.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Inya names the fear out loud. Naming the fear is what she needed to do to be ready.

bond_events.title: After the Combat Hall
bond_events.hook: Post-Drel-duel scene. Inya — alive, wounded or whole depending on outcomes — sits with Clovis briefly. Names what she took from the duel.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you ask what she took from the duel, help her write back, sit through the pain, or leave her the dignity of quiet?
bond_events.why_this_person: Inya needs a post-combat meaning scene so the duel is not just survival math.
bond_events.why_now: After Drel, her inherited form has either changed or broken.
bond_events.changes_after: Inya names what her tradition becomes after the campaign's violence.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Inya integrates her father's tradition with what she learned at the academy.

bond_events.title: The Village
bond_events.hook: Kitchen rotation. Lirah tells Clovis about her coastal village — the medic work, the tides, a child she delivered who is now old enough to ask questions. Does not name her partner.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you ask who she left behind, let the story stay gentle, offer a Wake story in return, or help with the work?
bond_events.why_this_person: Lirah is care under anger, and the care needs to appear before the anger does.
bond_events.why_now: A kitchen rotation is low-stakes enough for homesickness to breathe.
bond_events.changes_after: Lirah becomes a person who chose the academy at real cost, not simply the party healer.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Lirah's calm is technique. The kitchen is where the technique is most visible.

bond_events.title: The Letter
bond_events.hook: Lirah opens the letter from her partner three days after it arrives. Tells Clovis only what it says — only Clovis, in the kitchen at dawn.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you ask what the letter says, sit while she reads, tell her she can still go home, or help with breakfast without fixing anything?
bond_events.why_this_person: Lirah's care matters only if the player sees the life she left behind.
bond_events.why_now: Acts 2-3 give private emotional cost before Act 4 demands public triage.
bond_events.changes_after: Lirah's calm becomes legible as performed steadiness, not simple serenity.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Lirah is letting Clovis hold something only she has been holding.

bond_events.title: Anger in the Kitchen
bond_events.hook: Clovis catches Lirah crying in the kitchen after a long day. She tells him she misses her partner so much it makes her unable to sleep. He stays with her. Doesn't fix it.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you stay without fixing, name the anger, offer a Wake story, or ask what she wants from the academy now?
bond_events.why_this_person: Lirah is the care bond, and care has to include anger or it becomes flattening.
bond_events.why_now: Acts 3-4 are where hidden emotional costs should surface before the heist defense.
bond_events.changes_after: Lirah can stop performing calm for Clovis and later for Cilghal.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Lirah's calm is anger she has not allowed herself to feel. Clovis sitting with it without trying to fix it is the first time anyone has done so.

bond_events.title: Triage Hands Shaking
bond_events.hook: During the heist defense, Lirah works triage. The anger surfaces — she snaps at Cilghal, then at herself, finishes the work with hands shaking.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you steady her hands, call Cilghal, give her space, or tell her anger can still heal?
bond_events.why_this_person: Lirah's private bond must pay off under field pressure.
bond_events.why_now: Act 4 is where care becomes visibly costly and mechanically useful.
bond_events.changes_after: Lirah learns the cohort can witness her anger without withdrawing love.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Lirah is letting Cilghal in.

bond_events.title: The Small Object
bond_events.hook: Pre-resolution lull. If Lirah is the chosen companion, the conversation is small and the gift is smaller — she gives Clovis a stone from her village's beach.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you accept the stone, ask about the beach, promise to return it, or tell her what you carry from home?
bond_events.why_this_person: Lirah's final scene lets care become mutual instead of one-way.
bond_events.why_now: Act 5 needs a quiet object before the war-temple turns everything enormous.
bond_events.changes_after: Clovis carries a piece of Lirah's chosen life into the finale, making her more than triage support.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Lirah is letting Clovis carry a piece of where she came from into where she is going.

bond_events.title: The Argument She Keeps Winning
bond_events.hook: A dinner argument — Vesh defending the academy's institutional virtues, Clovis instinctively skeptical. Afterward, Vesh approaches Clovis and asks if she actually convinced him or if he was being polite.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you argue honestly, let Vesh win, ask what she is afraid of, or admit the academy has virtues you distrust?
bond_events.why_this_person: Vesh makes the institution's case from inside the cohort instead of from adult authority.
bond_events.why_now: Act 1 needs an academy defender before the academy is attacked.
bond_events.changes_after: Vesh becomes a peer whose confidence can crack, not just a political mouthpiece.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Vesh has noticed that her arguments are loudest when her uncertainty is highest.

bond_events.title: Bakura
bond_events.hook: After Vesh is cleared of suspicion, she tells Clovis why she defends the Republic so loudly. Names her father. Talks about Bakura.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you ask about Bakura, challenge the heroic version, let her keep present tense, or share a dead-family story of your own?
bond_events.why_this_person: Vesh tests the campaign's institution theme through grief wrapped in politics.
bond_events.why_now: Acts 2-3 are where false suspicion should become understanding, not just acquittal.
bond_events.changes_after: Vesh's Republic arguments become personal stakes instead of debate-club noise.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: The mythology is grief in a uniform. Vesh has known this. She has not said it.

bond_events.title: Three Things
bond_events.hook: Vesh tells Clovis what she said to Rann in the colonnade. Three specific things Rann was right about. She did not apologize.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you ask what the three things were, tell her Rann needed to hear them, challenge the lack of apology, or let the correction stand?
bond_events.why_this_person: Vesh's growth should show in how she treats Rann, not just in how she treats Clovis.
bond_events.why_now: Act 4 turns social arguments into repaired relationships under pressure.
bond_events.changes_after: Vesh becomes capable of being wrong without surrendering her whole identity.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Vesh is checking her work with a witness.

bond_events.title: Senator Karro's Coalition
bond_events.hook: Vesh tells Clovis what she found out about her mother's coalition — the names, the specific oversight provisions, the timeline. Asks Clovis what he would do if he were her.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you advise disclosure, strategy, defiance, or a narrower loyalty to the cohort first?
bond_events.why_this_person: Vesh brings the New Republic pressure inside the party without making canon politics solve the plot.
bond_events.why_now: Act 4 is where Senate oversight and academy survival collide.
bond_events.changes_after: Vesh chooses whether institutional loyalty means obedience, honesty, or protection.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Vesh is choosing between her mother's politics and her own honesty in slow motion.

bond_events.title: Discipline as Grief
bond_events.hook: Pre-resolution lull. If Vesh is the chosen companion, the conversation is brief and surprising — she tells Clovis she has decided that loyalty is a discipline, not a debt.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you ask what loyalty is for now, agree, disagree, or let the silence mark the choice?
bond_events.why_this_person: Vesh can state one clean version of the institution theme from inside the cohort.
bond_events.why_now: Act 5 needs her politics resolved into a playable personal discipline.
bond_events.changes_after: Vesh enters the finale less argumentative because she has chosen what her loyalty serves.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Vesh has stopped arguing because she does not need to.

bond_events.title: The Wordless Embrace
bond_events.hook: Loka finds Clovis somewhere Clovis looks unsettled and hugs him without asking. Does not speak. Holds long enough that Clovis remembers how to breathe.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you accept the embrace, freeze, pull away, or answer with a quiet gesture of your own?
bond_events.why_this_person: Loka gives care without demanding language, which is exactly what Clovis often needs.
bond_events.why_now: Early Act 1 can show the cohort caring before plot danger makes care heroic.
bond_events.changes_after: Loka becomes a low-dialogue emotional anchor and a reminder that not every bond needs explanation.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Loka has been tracking Clovis since the colonnade. The hug is the version of attention Clovis can receive without flinching.

bond_events.title: When You Asked
bond_events.hook: After Clovis has begun to suspect Joran but before the confrontation, Clovis asks Loka directly what he has been feeling about Joran. Loka — honest by default — confirms what he has felt.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you ask Loka to name the wrongness, ask why he stayed silent, defend Joran, or thank him for waiting to be asked?
bond_events.why_this_person: Loka's honesty should matter because he refuses accusation without cause.
bond_events.why_now: Act 3 is when suspicion needs witnesses beyond Clovis's own fear.
bond_events.changes_after: Clovis can no longer tell himself the wrongness is only his suspicion.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Loka was waiting to be asked. Wookiees do not accuse without cause.

bond_events.title: I Survived Because of You
bond_events.hook: Post-war-temple. Loka finds Clovis and says, in the slowest Shyriiwook he has ever used, the Wookiee phrase that means 'I survived because of you.'
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you answer in Basic, attempt Shyriiwook, touch foreheads, or simply receive the honor?
bond_events.why_this_person: Loka's bond is about quiet, nonverbal trust becoming formal recognition.
bond_events.why_now: Act 5 or the aftermath lets a small phrase carry survival's emotional weight.
bond_events.changes_after: Clovis receives proof that keeping someone alive can be named without spectacle.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: The phrase is the deepest formal honor Loka can offer.

bond_events.title: The Ration Bar
bond_events.hook: Iila finds Clovis somewhere he looks unsettled and offers her ration bar. She does not eat it. She offers it. Asks him a too-direct question that turns out to be wisdom.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you take the ration bar, answer the too-direct question, dodge it, or give Iila something back?
bond_events.why_this_person: Iila is small enough to be underestimated and direct enough to cut through Clovis's performance.
bond_events.why_now: Her kindness must precede her Act 2 wound so the wound is felt, not merely reported.
bond_events.changes_after: Iila becomes part of the player's emotional map of the cohort before danger reaches younger students.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Iila has been taking care of herself since age nine. The brightness is discipline.

bond_events.title: The Question She Saved
bond_events.hook: Iila finds Clovis after the confrontation with Joran. Asks him, with terrifying clarity, whether he is going to be all right. Does not want to be told yes if it is not true.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you answer truthfully, lie to reassure her, ask why she saved the question, or admit you do not know yet?
bond_events.why_this_person: Iila is the cohort's heart because she asks for truth, not because she is innocent.
bond_events.why_now: Act 3 needs a small honest question after the Joran rupture.
bond_events.changes_after: Clovis either receives care from the youngest student or teaches her that adults still dodge truth.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Iila has been the cohort's heart on purpose. She is asking Clovis to receive the heart-work for once.

bond_events.title: A Normal Morning
bond_events.hook: Pre-war-temple OR post-war-temple. Iila wants a normal morning with Clovis. Breakfast. A walk, maybe. The kind of morning that means tomorrow exists.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you give her the normal morning, promise tomorrow, refuse to promise what danger may take, or ask what ordinary thing she wants first?
bond_events.why_this_person: Iila turns survival stakes into the right to ordinary life.
bond_events.why_now: Act 5 needs one reminder that victory means tomorrow, not only defeating Vornn.
bond_events.changes_after: Iila's survival or loss lands as the campaign's clearest measure of whether the cohort protected its heart.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Iila is asking the cohort to remember that ordinariness is also work.

bond_events.title: The ID in the Drawer
bond_events.hook: Brann shows Clovis his old Imperial Academy cadet ID — the small chrome rectangle he has not destroyed. Says he has been waiting to know whether he is the kind of person who destroys it.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you tell Brann to destroy the ID, keep it as evidence, keep it as a warning, or decide that objects are not absolution?
bond_events.why_this_person: Brann turns Imperial history into a personal cost the player can touch.
bond_events.why_now: The question must exist before the ambush makes his old training useful.
bond_events.changes_after: Brann becomes the investigation partner whose competence is inseparable from the system that hurt him.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Brann has been carrying the question of his own selection for years.

bond_events.title: Reading What He Was Trained to Read
bond_events.hook: Long hours over a datapad in the perimeter watch hut. Brann teaches Clovis to read Imperial-era operational signatures. Clovis teaches Brann smuggler-style false-flag patterns.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you learn the Imperial pattern, challenge the training, trade smuggler false-flags, or ask what using it costs him?
bond_events.why_this_person: Brann's value is inseparable from the harm that made him useful.
bond_events.why_now: Acts 2-3 are the investigation spine, and Brann is the party's clearest investigative tool.
bond_events.changes_after: Clovis can read the cell better and understand why Brann's competence is painful.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Brann is using what was done to him in service of the people the Empire trained him against.

bond_events.title: Last Stand at the Perimeter
bond_events.hook: Act 4 second pinch point. Brann holds the perimeter against Captain Thane's force long enough for the cohort to consolidate. The bond event is whether Clovis is with him at the end.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you stand with Brann, order him back, use his pattern read, or make sure his name is carried if he falls?
bond_events.why_this_person: Brann's bond exists so the cost of protection has a face and a witness.
bond_events.why_now: Act 4 is where the investigation partner's old training becomes the price of survival.
bond_events.changes_after: Brann's fate becomes named sacrifice, living cost, or lonely consequence depending on the bond.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Brann's death is the campaign's deepest cost in most branches. The bond event determines whether he dies witnessed and named, or alone.

bond_events.title: The Merc Story
bond_events.hook: On the off-world mission to the Tion-fringe shadowport, three days in close quarters. Kyle tells Clovis one story about his own merc-to-Jedi transition — the version Luke does not know.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you ask for the version Luke does not know, challenge the mercenary lesson, admit the story helps, or keep the comparison at arm's length?
bond_events.why_this_person: Kyle lets Clovis imagine a practical Jedi path without making Luke wrong.
bond_events.why_now: Act 3's off-world mission is when Clovis needs a mentor who understands fringe instincts.
bond_events.changes_after: Kyle becomes permission for Clovis to integrate the Wake and the Praxeum rather than choose one identity cleanly.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Kyle is recognizing in Clovis a path that mirrors his own.

bond_events.title: Two Traditions
bond_events.hook: Late evening in the Praxeum's training hall. Kyle and Clovis spar without ceremony. Afterward, the conversation is about what kind of Jedi Clovis is becoming — the contemplative kind Luke teaches, or the practical kind Kyle teaches.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you claim Luke's way, Kyle's way, a third thing, or refuse the need to define yourself yet?
bond_events.why_this_person: Kyle is the safest canon mentor to pressure Clovis's Jedi identity without stealing the plot.
bond_events.why_now: Act 4 is the last reflective space before the final mission fixes consequences.
bond_events.changes_after: Clovis's self-definition as a Jedi becomes more playable in the ending narration.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Kyle is offering Clovis permission to be a different Jedi than Luke is teaching.

bond_events.title: Fighting Together at the Temple
bond_events.hook: The war-temple climax. At some point during the fight, Clovis and Kyle find themselves back-to-back briefly. No conversation. After, Kyle says only: 'You're going to be all right.' Walks on.
bond_events.choice_prompt: Do you accept Kyle's peer recognition, brush it off, answer with a field joke, or ask whether he believes it?
bond_events.why_this_person: Kyle can validate Clovis without canon authority taking over the climax.
bond_events.why_now: Act 5 gives one brief mentor payoff after Clovis has made his own choices.
bond_events.changes_after: Clovis leaves the campaign seen as a peer by someone who knows both soldiering and Jedi life.
bond_events.subversion_payoff: Kyle has chosen Clovis as a peer.

bond_event_system.purpose: Optional one-on-one scenes that deepen specific cohort relationships and weight the climax mechanically. Cohort survival in Act 5 is determined by accumulated bond_weight per character.
bond_event_system.selection_model: Clovis-only relationship scenes. Offer bond events as optional one-on-one scenes when the current act is inside the event window, prerequisites have fired, and the player has shown interest through choices, checks, or scene focus. Do not offer them as generic social filler.

ending_weight_notes.Joran Veska: Primary ending lever. High bond makes Open Door or Long Road possible; low bond pushes Law or What Remains.
ending_weight_notes.Rann Veska: Controls whether Rann accepts Clovis as witness, accomplice, or betrayer after the Joran choice.
ending_weight_notes.Tarsh Voll: Support bond. High bond makes the academy infrastructure and Horizon repairs feel earned, but does not replace the Joran spine.
ending_weight_notes.Brann Riako: Cost lever. High bond determines whether Brann's likely Act 4 death is witnessed, named, and mechanically useful.
ending_weight_notes.Cohort: The pre-resolution lull chooses the strongest surviving bond among Lirah, Inya, Rann, Cassen, or Tarsh unless the player deliberately chooses otherwise.

bond_event_system.stacking: additive across events with the same cohort_member
